name: Yajima Shinobu
source:
A popular, energetic girl in the same class as the protagonist and Yuuri.
As a hard worker and a sports scholarship student, she is admired by many at the school. However, contrary to that image, behind closed doors she is also the ringleader of the group bullying Yuuri.
translation:
A popular, energetic girl in the same class as the protagonist and Yuuri.
As a hard worker and a sports scholarship student, she is admired by many at the school. However, contrary to that image, behind closed doors she is also the ringleader of the group bullying Yuuri.
